digest.component_or_area: outbound differ / reconciler vendor adapter seam
propositions: The outbound differ compares fields in vendor shape while the inbound differ compares in canonical shape, creating an asymmetry that blocks epic bbf1 AC3 and violates ADR 0035 §(d).

The outbound update path must canonicalize the snapshot via InboundMapper before comparison, diff in local field names, and emit vendor payloads only via a new OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote() method at the emission boundary.

The Jira InboundMapper output must be widened with three new canonical keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) for neutral field comparison, while the assignee resolver is re-homed to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee() with unchanged payload contract.

The stored per-binding baseline remains vendor-shaped at rest (opaque, no migration); canonicalization and comparison occur at read time, with map_remote_to_local tolerating partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subsets by emitting only keys whose vendor source is present.

The outbound differ must contain no adapters.jira imports, no vendor snapshot key literals, and only neutral canonical-name field-comparison helpers; vendor-shaped helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches) become adapter-internal to adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py.

Decision-for-decision equivalence (old vs. new) must be proven via characterization suite covering status/priority maps, assignee shapes, parent changes, description fit+rstrip, labels, baseline conflicts, and the non-authoritative resolver fallback.
